item.title: If we want to settle on other planets, we’ll have to use genome editing to alter human DNA
item.description: When considering human settlements on the Moon, Mars and further afield, much attention is given to the travel times, food and radiation risk.

item.title: Trump is driving the US into creating world disorder!!!

item.title: Immortality at a price: how the promise of delaying death has become a consumer marketing bonanza
item.description: The global longevity market – spanning gene therapies, anti-ageing drugs, diagnostics and wellness plans – is projected to hit US$610 billion this year.

item.title: Why global environmental negotiations keep failing – and what we can do about it
item.description: The stakes are high. Every delay means more emissions. The world cannot afford negotiations that stall while ecosystems collapse.

item.title: The Inquisition – one of the most appalling gifts to human tyranny
